name: feature-velocity
blurb: Dark 3-column grid showcasing tech features with gradient hover reveals.
description: Three feature cards (Neural Link, Data Core, Fluid UI) with icons on a striped dark background. Cards reveal gradient overlays on hover.
use_when: Tech product landing pages where sleek dark design and hover effects create premium perception.
avoid_when: High-contrast accessibility contexts where dark cards with subtle gradients may fail standards.
a11y: Icons are decorative; text is semantic and readable. Hover gradient reveals are visual feedback only.
